newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CPC International lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CPC International lowered.

text.p: Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette cut its rating on the shares of CPC International Inc to market perform from buy, due to a weaker outlook for CPC's operations in Latin America and Europe, a firm source said.
-- The analyst lowered his 1997 earnings estimate for CPC to $3.90 per share from $4.00 per share, and his 1998 estimate to $4.85 per share from $4.95 per share, the source said.

-- The rating was lowered because company guidance suggested that for the second quarter, CPC's results would be down in Latin America and flat in Europe, the source said. These regions posted higher results in the first quarter.
-- CPC's stock was also trading near its highs, the source said. It was trading off 3/8 at 85-1/4.
